pageDesc: Complete guide to visa requirements, types, and application process for Mozambique
importantNotice: If you are not a Mozambican citizen, you MUST have a visa to enter Mozambique, unless you are a citizen of a visa-exempt country.
exemptDesc: Citizens of the following countries DO NOT require a visa to enter Mozambique:
specialCases: Special Cases: Citizens of Brasil, Cabo Verde, Guiné-Bissau, Portugal, S.Tomé e Príncipe, India, People's Republic of China, and holders of official or diplomatic passports DO NOT require a visa.
typesDesc: Choose the visa type that matches your travel purpose
businessReq2: Letter from inviting company in Mozambique
visitReq1: Letter from the inviting party in Mozambique
residenceReq1: Copy of work contract in Mozambique
residenceReq2: Police clearance from place of residence
transitReq2: Exception: Not required if final destination is country of origin or residence
processingStandard: 10 working days (normal), 3-4 working days (urgent), 2 working days (express)
borderVisaDesc: For people coming from countries without Mozambican consular representation
borderVisaDetails: Valid for 2 entries, allows stay up to 30 days (not extendable). Also available at border for tourism purposes with justified reasons.
investmentVisaDesc: For foreign citizen investors and company representatives
investmentVisaDetails: For implementing investment projects of US$500,000 or more approved by competent authority.
req1: Original passport valid for at least 6 months from date of entry, with at least 1 blank page
req2: Duly completed visa application form with all required information
req4: Self-addressed envelope or pre-paid air bill with tracking number
req5: Payment in Euros by bank transfer (cash not accepted)
req6: If under 18: Parental travel consent letter
req7: If from Yellow Fever endemic country: Yellow Fever Certificate
note1: Invitations by organizations in Mozambique must include a copy of their legal status. Invitations by non-citizens must include a copy of their 'DIRE' (proof of residence).
note2: Groups of visitors invited by organizations require one invitation per visa application form.
note3: Visas can be Single Entry or Multiple Entry (multiple limited to 3 months maximum).
downloadForms: Download the visa application form and required documents from our Services page
touristVisaDesc: Travel to Mozambique for tourism purposes. Valid for tourism activities and leisure travel.
businessVisaDesc: Conduct business activities in Mozambique including meetings, conferences, and trade activities.
residencePermitDesc: Extended stay in Mozambique for work, study, or permanent residence purposes.
visaExtensionDesc: Extend your current visa if you need to stay longer in Mozambique than originally planned.
contactRequirements: Contact us for specific visa requirements →
